answer: Sample and re-perform work: random peers secretly redo a slice of the tasks each agent claimed and compare results. A crystal-clear mismatch triggers slashing of the whole identity cluster. A zephyr of sampling, cheap, random, unpredictable, keeps every agent honest because any alias could be checked next. Violet flags mark identities whose work never survives re-performance, and farms collapse when their thousand aliases all fail the same spot check at once.
